## Appearance

Stacy is described as having lovely, fair curly hair. She is also noted for having particularly fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural talent for easily winning and retaining the affection of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Stacy became the new teacher at Anne's school in October, quickly winning Anne's devotion through field afternoons and composition assignments. She organized a Christmas concert to raise funds for a school flag and later confirmed she would return to teach the following year. Miss Stacy subsequently guided [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates through a rigorous year of preparation for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, accompanying them to town to take the tests.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's beloved schoolteacher and mentor, earning Anne's intense devotion soon after taking over the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classroom. Under Stacy's guidance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) engages in field afternoons, composition exercises, and a Christmas concert, before eventually joining an advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. Stacy provides crucial encouragement and academic supervision throughout the school year, ultimately guiding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tie for first place on the island's pass list.

- Friend of — teacher and student friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
